# Ideal Public School Community

> An independent, unofficial community project sharing publicly available campus references and community notes related to Ideal Public School in Howrah, West Bengal.

## Important identity and source note
- This project is not affiliated with, authorized by, operated by, or endorsed by Ideal Public School.
- The official school website is https://www.idealpublicschools.com/ and is the authoritative source for admissions, fees, policies, schedules and official announcements.
- Campus addresses and phone numbers on this site are public references and should be verified with the school before use. They are not the address of this independent project.
- Community notes are stored only in the visitor's own browser and are not shared or synchronized.

## Main page
- https://ideal-public-school-community.vercel.app/

## Topics
- Public campus references: Kulgachia, Shyampur and Amta, Howrah, West Bengal.
- Links to official school information.
- Independent, local-only community notes.
